Inject KeePass secrets into a child process

Usage: kprun <COMMAND>

Commands:
  init           Create or attach a KeePass vault and unlock it
  run            Inject vault secrets into a child process
  list           List vault entries and their secret key names
  get            Show custom fields for a vault entry
  set            Set or update secret fields on a vault entry
  unset          Remove secret fields from a vault entry
  delete         Delete a vault entry
  export         Export vault entries to JSON or dotenv
  import         Import entries from JSON or dotenv into the vault
  migrate        Migrate a plaintext project .env file into the vault
  doctor         Diagnose configuration and print an MCP config snippet
  mcp            Bridge stdio JSON-RPC to a remote HTTP MCP server, injecting vault-backed auth headers
  reveal-master  Print the master password stored in the OS keychain for the current vault (stderr warning + audit)
  deinit         Remove the stored master password for the current vault from the OS keychain
  scan           Fast heuristic check for committed secrets. Not a substitute for dedicated scanners like gitleaks or trufflehog
  agents         Install a secrets policy for coding agents (AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md)
  help           Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help     Print help
  -V, --version  Print version
